column1: # Session 95 (PLAIN): GPUs with no family row, on the PC through the emulate switches. Only limits/features/formats the phone has LESS of can be emulated.
# On the PC the emulated unknown vendor keeps its PC class (is_android is the REAL platform), so gpu_plain_mode=auto only fires for a mobile vendor id
# (Samsung 144D: Xclipse); an unknown vendor needs --gpu_plain_mode=on here. On a phone, auto fires for every unknown vendor (quirks_test covers that).
# Expected log: "[quirks] plain: ON (...)" then one "[quirks] plain: <flag> <old> to <new>" line per flag that was not already off.
# The known-family profiles to run beside these (flags must stay unchanged, "[quirks] plain: off (... known family ...)"): a642 (profiles_a642.tsv),
